title: HealthMamba: An Uncertainty-aware Spatiotemporal Graph State Space Model for Effective and Reliable Healthcare Facility Visit Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2602.05286v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Healthcare facility visit prediction is essential for optimizing healthcare resource allocation and informing public health policy. Despite advanced machine learning methods being employed for better prediction performance, existing works usually formulate this task as a time-series forecasting problem without considering the intrinsic spatial dependencies of different types of healthcare facilities, and they also fail to provide reliable predictions under abnormal situations such as public emergencies. To advance existing research, we propose HealthMamba, an uncertainty-aware spatiotemporal framework for accurate and reliable healthcare facility visit prediction. translated_title: HealthMamba：一种不确定性感知的时空图状态空间模型，用于有效且可靠的医疗机构就诊预测
translated_abstract: 医疗机构就诊预测对于优化医疗资源配置和制定公共卫生政策至关重要。尽管现有研究采用了先进的机器学习方法以提升预测性能，但它们通常将此任务表述为时间序列预测问题，而未考虑不同类型医疗机构之间固有的空间依赖关系，并且在突发公共卫生事件等异常情况下也难以提供可靠的预测。为了推进现有研究，我们提出了HealthMamba，一个用于实现准确且可靠的医疗机构就诊预测的不确定性感知时空框架。HealthMamba包含三个关键组件： 统一时空上下文编码器，用于融合异构的静态与动态信息； 一种名为GraphMamba的新型图状态空间模型，用于分层时空建模； 一个全面的不确定性（估计模块，摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出了不确定性感知的时空框架HealthMamba，通过统一时空上下文编码器融合静态与动态信息、利用新型图状态空间模型GraphMamba进行分层时空建模，实现准确且可靠的医疗机构就诊预测。
en_tdlr: HealthMamba is an uncertainty-aware spatiotemporal framework that combines a unified spatiotemporal context encoder, a novel GraphMamba state space model, and uncertainty estimation to achieve accurate and reliable healthcare facility visit prediction.
